meta.name: The Biggest Game in Town
meta.description: Some people fold their dreams, others go all in. A Landscaper, a realtor and an old mob boss chase down a dream and embark on a one-of-a-kind poker adventure in search of a legendary card game. A dream turns into a premonition and our hero has to face his fears against the best poker player you've never heard of in "The Biggest Game in Town".
meta.slogan: Some people fold their dreams... others go all in.
